registry_info.name: foundations
registry_info.description: Artifacts for the Foundations Crisis sequence - Gödel, Russell, Escher, Magritte, Florensky

godel_statement_plaque.description: Self-referential plaque cycling through increasingly paradoxical statements, culminating in Gödel's incompleteness
godel_statement_plaque.qfep_connection: Proves pure F-minimization is impossible - every formal system has an outside

russell_set_box.description: Nested boxes visualizing Russell's Paradox - the set of all sets that don't contain themselves
russell_set_box.qfep_connection: Self-reference creates edges in formal systems

parameters.max_visible_depth: How many nested boxes before infinite indicator

magritte_pipe.description: 'Ceci n'est pas une pipe' - The gap between representation and reality
magritte_pipe.qfep_connection: F (predictive model) ≠ reality. The map is not the territory.
interactions: click to cycle through meta-layers of representation

escher_staircase.description: Impossible staircase - locally coherent, globally impossible. Visual Gödel.
escher_staircase.qfep_connection: Local validity does not guarantee global consistency
interactions: climb_step() to ascend forever and return to start

parameters.steps_per_side: Number of steps on each side of the square

florensky_sphere.description: Paraconsistent logic sphere - holds A and not-A simultaneously without collapse
florensky_sphere.gamwell_reference: Chapter 3: Florensky's 'Pillar and Ground of the Truth' - supralogic
florensky_sphere.qfep_connection: QFEP allows holding order (F) and disorder (-λE) without triviality

bifurcation_diagram.description: Interactive 3D bifurcation diagram from logistic map - walk through the edge of chaos
bifurcation_diagram.qfep_connection: The λ parameter IS Langton's λ - tunes between order and chaos
